result.topic_en: Euler finishes the difference-subtraction test showing 99733 is prime, then in Example 4 finds the factorization 96853 = 23·4211. In Example 5 he begins testing N = 64013 (a = 40, b = 1), where only the lower sign applies, so terms of the form 40(80s − 13ss) must be added to bb = 1.

Hic

Nova Acta Acad. Imp. Scient. Tom. XIV. \quad D \quad §. 41.

=== 35 ===

Hic jam occurrit numerus quadratus $*361 = 19^2$ ipſi $yy$ aequandus. Fit igitur $y = 19$, $s = -5$, hincque $x = 48$, unde factor numeri propoſiti inveniri poteſt quaerendo fractionem $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{x \pm a}{y \pm b} = \frac{48-17}{81-19}[?] = \frac{1}{2}$; hinc factor eſt $40pp + 13qq = 40 \cdot 1^2 + 13 \cdot 2^2$[?], qui ad minimos terminos reductus eſt $10 \cdot 1^2 + 13 \cdot 1^2 = 23$. Alter factor ex eadem fractione derivari poteſt, ſi ſumatur $\frac{p}{q} = \frac{65}{62}$[?]; hinc enim fiet $40pp + 13qq = 40 \cdot 65^2 + 13 \cdot 62^2$[?], qui factor per $4 \cdot 13$ depreſſus dat $10 \cdot 65 \cdot 5 + 31^2 = 4211$[?]: at revera eſt $96853 = 23 \cdot 4211$.

Exemplum 5.

§. 57. Sumatur $a = 40$ et $b = 1$ et numerus examinandus erit $N = 64013$. Hic autem modus procedendi a praecedentibus diverſus adhiberi debet; quia enim a quadratis $bb$ ſubtrahi deberent numeri in forma $40(13ss + 80s)$ contenti, quod autem fieri nequit, hic ſolum ſignum inferius valebit, ita ut ſucceſſive ad quadratum $bb = 1$ addi debeant numeri in forma $S = 40(80s - 13ss)$ contenti, quos cum ſuis differentiis hic adjungamus.

items.quote: Quia igitur hic nullum quadratum resultat, numerus 99733 etiam pro primo eſt habendus.
items.english: Since no square results here, the number 99733 must also be regarded as prime.
Let b = 81 again and a = 17; then N = 96853 (to be examined for primality).

items.quote: Sumatur $a = 40$ et $b = 1$ et numerus examinandus erit $N = 64013$.
items.english: Let a = 40 and b = 1; the number to be examined will be N = 64013.

items.quote: hic ſolum ſignum inferius valebit, ita ut ſucceſſive ad quadratum $bb = 1$ addi debeant numeri in forma $S = 40(80s - 13ss)$ contenti
items.english: Here only the lower sign will hold, so that numbers of the form S = 40(80s − 13ss) must be successively added to the square bb = 1.
